text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whooosh, whooosh...)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: August 16th...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Remember... I will never forget this date. 
And—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The people of this country surely won't 
forget either. Not 9 days, but 16 days...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On that day—history was rewritten.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Taiki Shuttle wins! Taiki Shuttle finally 
achieves the long-cherished first European 
G1 victory!!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
For the first time ever, an Umamusume 
belonging to Tracen Academy— Has risen to 
the very top of the world!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yes！ Yes……！ Yes,Yes,Yes！

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Thank you all sooo much for your support！

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And people around the world watched that 
victory with a myriad of feelings in their 
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Old Lady Guide
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, that was an incredible race. 
Well, some girls are just promised success 
from the start.

text_block_list.name: Old Lady Guide
text_block_list.text:
It's a world that folks like us have no 
business in anyway. The best we can do is 
just look up at it, I reckon...

text_block_list.name: Young American Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Incredible... Ms. Taiki Shuttle...

text_block_list.name: Young American Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I... can't win like this... Always in 
2nd... nothing but 2nd place...

text_block_list.name: Young American Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Even if I try my best... is it impossible?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad from the bottom of my heart for 
Taiki's glory... but... you look a little 
sadness, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy, but frustrated at the same 
time. Still...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now the stage is set! Beat Taiki, and 
you're the best in the world! That's the 
formula.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Everything is going according to plan. And 
now, I have—
choice_data_list: Yeah, you've got the strength to win!
Yeah, you have what it takes to win!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(You really did it, Taiki! You went and 
did it! However—)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Then I will surpass that version of you! 
Hyaaaaaaaaaahhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spurred on by that final fierce late 
surge, Seeking the Pearl's speed reached a 
level rivalling the top Umamusume of the 
world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With how my legs are running now, I can 
take on Taiki Shuttle. The stage is set.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Now, if only Taiki Shuttle shows up in 
the race we're anticipating..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back, Taiki Shuttle-san! Please 
give a message of triumph to your fans!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"Will you be resting for a while from now 
on? Or do you already have plans to enter 
another race?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What? Next, desu ka? Next is...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"I will run in the Sprinters Stakes! 
Because I am full of energy!"

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Ooooh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The live broadcast from the airport 
confirmed that Taiki Shuttle's schedule 
was right on track as expected.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes, I knew that was coming.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Because—hehe♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I received a message from Pearl-san after 
her victory!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! Next up, let's face off 
in the Sprinters Stakes! ...Wait, what?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Seeking the Pearl smiles. A seeker never 
leaves their destiny to others.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Driven entirely by her own will, moving 
even those around her. Toward the destined 
showdown."
